description: This file contains unit tests for the system information module of the WPEFramework project, utilizing Google Test framework. It includes tests for system architecture, firmware version, CPU info, memory info, uptime, and device ID retrieval, with platform-specific code for POSIX systems.

classes.name: Purpose
classes.description: Enumeration representing different purposes for system info queries such as memory, swap, host, chipset, and CPU load.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: Enumeration representing different memory functions like total, free, available, cached, and none.

methods.name: Round
methods.description: Rounds a double value to a specified number of decimal places.

methods.name: Architecture
methods.description: Retrieves system architecture string on POSIX systems.

methods.name: FirmwareVersion
methods.description: Retrieves system firmware version string on POSIX systems.

methods.name: GetChipset
methods.description: Extracts chipset model name from system command output.

methods.name: GetCPUJiffies
methods.description: Calculates total CPU jiffies from system command output.

methods.name: GetCPULoad
methods.description: Calculates CPU load percentage from system command output.

methods.name: GetMemoryValue
methods.description: Extracts memory value from command output based on context.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Retrieves total, free, cached, or available memory info from system command output.

methods.name: GetSwapMemory
methods.description: Retrieves swap memory info from system command output.

methods.name: ExecuteCmd
methods.description: Executes a system command and processes its output based on purpose and function.

methods.name: GetUpTime
methods.description: Reads system uptime from /proc/uptime and returns it in seconds.

methods.name: RawDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the first network interface as device ID.
